title: The charge decomposition carries a conserved signed spectral Noether measure

spectral_noether_measure.symmetry: For each Borel B, multiplying P_B phi by a constant phase while fixing P_(B^c)phi leaves Q, D_A, ||phi||^2 and the repository action invariant.
spectral_noether_measure.charge: C(B)=integral_T3 Im<P_B phi,P_B pi> dx is the Noether charge of that independent spectral-subspace phase.
spectral_noether_measure.conservation: The projected matter equation has a real self-adjoint spatial operator and real radial multiplier, so dC(B)/dt=0 for every B on every smooth solution and then by density on the admitted strong flow.
spectral_noether_measure.countable_additivity: Orthogonality of disjoint spectral projectors makes C countably additive; C is a finite signed measure with total variation bounded by ||phi||_2 ||pi||_2.
spectral_noether_measure.moments: Whenever phi and pi have the required Q-graph regularity, integral q^k dC(q)=integral_T3 Im<Q^k phi,pi> dx and is conserved.
spectral_noether_measure.gauge_invariance: P_B commutes with exp(i alpha Q), and the transformed Cauchy pair is pointwise unitary, so C(B) descends through the K1400 gauge quotient.
spectral_noether_measure.boundary: C is signed and symplectic rather than a positive energy measure. Its conservation neither controls high-charge norms nor selects the compact generator or observed charges.
